body: The premier open source Data Quality solution
plain_description: The premier open source Data Quality solution. Profile, correct, and enrich your data to improve accuracy and trust. Use it for ad-hoc analysis, recurring cleansing, and Master Data Management.
technical_description: DataCleaner is a Java-based data quality toolkit for profiling, correcting, and enriching datasets. The modular architecture provides an engine core, a public API for custom extensions, and a Swing-based desktop UI. It supports job-based execution with configurable components for filtering, transforming, and analyzing data across databases, CSV, Excel, Hadoop, and other datastores.
title: DataCleaner
